definitions.gloss: air raid; aerial attack; air strike
definitions.explanation: An attack from aircraft, especially the bombing of cities or military targets. In Japanese, most strongly associated with the Allied bombing campaigns against Japan in World War II.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{空|くう}→空〜：03949_kuu⟧ (sky, air) and {襲|しゅう} (attack, raid). In Japanese historical context, {空襲|くうしゅう} most commonly refers to the American bombing raids on Japanese cities during World War II, particularly the firebombing campaigns of 1945.

ETYMOLOGY:
The ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{大空襲|だいくうしゅう} (Great Tokyo Air Raid) of March 10, 1945, is the most devastating single air raid in history. Many other major Japanese cities were also subjected to {空襲|くうしゅう}. The word carries heavy historical weight and appears frequently in war memoirs, textbooks, and peace education.

- {空襲|くうしゅう}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧ — air raid warning/siren
- {空襲|くうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ — to be hit by an air raid
- {大空襲|だいくうしゅう} — great air raid, massive bombing
- {空襲|くうしゅう}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ — air raid damage
